args.description: Game skill effect sprite, side view: a small bolt of arcane mana flying to the right: an indigo and violet energy dart with a bright white core and a short tapering trail of tiny sky-blue sparkles. Restrained version: compact size, fewer particles, small glow core, clean readable shape. Detailed 16-bit pixel art in the same art style and palette mood as the reference swamp monster: solid parts (ice, rock, chains) have bold dark outlines and 3-4 step shading; glowing energy parts are bright with a hot near-white core fading to saturated color, crisp stepped pixel edges, no blur. Layered composition: a bright core shape, secondary shapes, and small scattered particles. No crosses, no star or crescent symbols, no religious symbols, no letters or runes. Only the effect: no characters, no people, no silhouettes, no creatures, no weapons, no staff, no text, transparent background.
